edge.rule: §5.7 (registered): a winner on the edge of a numeric axis -> that axis extended once, one step outward, at the winner's other coordinates; at most 3 extension runs per stage; re-applied over the union; the winner again on the new edge -> EDGE_UNRESOLVED; no second extension
unstepped_edges: client LR 0.1 has no registered step (§5.7)
